title: Auth Contract
description: Declares which estate-approved auth modes a service accepts. Used by SVC-003 governance and estate tooling. The approved mode set is closed; new modes require a standards change.

accepted_modes.description: Non-empty list of mode entries. Each entry declares one approved auth mode plus the metadata required by that mode. uniqueItems catches structurally identical duplicates; the evaluator enforces uniqueness by mode id.

audience.description: Bare literal app-id (e.g. 'scp', 'scp-dev', 'pim'), matching the service's key in services.yml. Not a URI. Required for mode.user_oidc and mode.service_rs256.

jwks_url.description: Full URL of the JWKS endpoint used to verify signatures. Required for mode.user_oidc and mode.service_rs256.

issuer.description: Key issuer identifier. Required for mode.api_key (e.g. 'control-tower').

key_id_prefix.description: Optional key-id prefix the service validates against (e.g. 'ct-agent-'). Lets the evaluator cross-reference the declared prefix with the issuer's convention. Applies to mode.api_key.

deprecation_close_date.description: ISO date after which mode.bearer_legacy fails the SVC-003 auto-check. Comparison is evaluator logic, not schema validation.

waiver_ref.description: waiver_id of a waiver record in output/findings/waivers.json that authorises the service to run on mode.bearer_legacy until the close date.

notes.description: Optional free-text note. Must not carry load-bearing contract data.
